Chapter 3 — Andrea Doria

Eleven Hours in the Fog

1956.07.25 GENOA → NEW YORK

This game is based on the collision on the night of July 25, 1956, off Nantucket, Massachusetts, USA, between the Italian liner Andrea Doria and the Swedish liner Stockholm. Of the 1,706 people aboard the Andrea Doria, 46 died, along with 5 crew members of the Stockholm.

It was made with respect for those who died, so that you can walk through what happened that day and see it with your own eyes. The protagonist and some characters and conversations are fictional. Times, figures and details of the ships are based on sources such as Wikipedia.

This game includes scenes of a ship collision, a listing ship, and the number of people who died. If you have been through painful experiences with accidents or disasters, please take care of yourself.
